note: Round 6 (2026-10-11), written from what the operator placed: real-world field recordings were kept 8 of 9 times and rich specific scenes 39%, while the round 4/5 "one single hit, dry, close-mic" template was kept 6%, ethereal swells 1 of 90 and anything with a bell or chime 4 of 100. So: one concrete place per identity (Bant is a harbour), a different real source in every cell, the plain recording suffix, and bells, chimes and gongs refused. Written by make-round6.py.
suffix: High-quality, stereo, 44.1kHz, sound effect, field recording.
negative: low quality, muffled, lo-fi, hiss, distortion, clipping, bell, bells, chime, chimes, gong, glockenspiel, music, melody, song, speech, voice, vocals, singing
